metadata.important_rule: Observed questions are kept separate from inferred company patterns. Inferences never become facts without repeated, role-matched evidence.

extraction_method.input: Publicly readable search results and public pages only
steps: Discover company, role, India, round and recent-interview pages.
Extract each report's role, level, location, date, outcome, rounds and question details.
Normalize synonymous round names such as DSA/coding and HLD/system design.
Separate exact or paraphrased observed questions from general topic mentions.
Group evidence by company, role family, level, location and time period.
Infer company-specific evaluation signals only from repeated evidence or clearly labeled single reports.
Assign confidence: high for repeated recent evidence, medium for multiple consistent reports, low for one report or editorial inference.
Preserve conflicts instead of averaging incompatible interview loops.

knowledge_base_generation.company_profile: Derived from repeated process patterns, question clusters, role context and company domain; not copied from a single page.
knowledge_base_generation.question_bank: Contains only questions or tasks explicitly observed or clearly paraphrased from public reports. Questions inferred from job descriptions are marked low confidence and should not be presented as previously asked.
knowledge_base_generation.round_model: Round names are normalized, then grouped by company, role, level and India location. Conflicting loops remain separate variants.
knowledge_base_generation.mindset_model: Mindset is an evidence-backed hypothesis about what the company appears to value, based on repeated evaluation signals and domain-specific tasks.

personalization_use.software_engineer: Select DSA, backend, LLD/HLD and behavioral questions matching the target level and company variant.
personalization_use.ai_engineer: Select ML fundamentals, AI system design, model evaluation, practical AI tasks and relevant software engineering questions.
personalization_use.follow_ups: Use the observed evaluation signals to ask about trade-offs, scale, testing, failure modes, metrics and project ownership.
personalization_use.disclosure: Show candidates whether an item is official, repeatedly reported, single-report evidence, or an inferred practice scenario.

confidence_policy.high: Repeated recent evidence from multiple independent role-matched reports.
confidence_policy.medium: A detailed candidate report or multiple consistent but limited reports.
confidence_policy.low: Single report, editorial synthesis, inferred question, ambiguous company identity or old evidence.

facts: Meta officially describes a full loop of roughly 4–6 conversations covering coding, design and behavioral evaluation.
Meta has a separate Machine Learning interview guide covering coding, ML system design and behavioral evaluation.
new_official_signals.knowledge_effect: Raises confidence that coding/design/behavioral is a real process structure and separates ML system design from generic SWE design.

new_official_signals.source: Google India job descriptions and Google DeepMind careers material
facts: India engineering roles explicitly emphasize data structures and algorithms, software design, testing, deployment, distributed computing and large-scale systems.
AI-oriented engineering roles connect software engineering with machine learning, deep learning, research and responsible AI.
The exact interview process is role-specific; Google DeepMind explicitly describes recruiter, skills and final leadership stages rather than one universal loop.
new_official_signals.knowledge_effect: Strengthens the distinction between observed coding questions and role-derived preparation areas such as distributed systems, ML depth and deployment.

newly_added_inference_guards: Official job descriptions are used to explain why a topic is relevant, not to claim that the topic was asked in an interview.
Editorial guides and duplicated reports are retained as leads but cannot independently raise a question to high confidence.
A company knowledge base must preserve multiple process variants instead of producing one canonical round sequence.
AI-specific questions are separated from standard SWE questions so an AI Engineer plan does not merely become a generic DSA plan.

Google: Reliable separation of Google SWE, Google Cloud and DeepMind loops
Sarvam AI: Official interview guide or role-specific hiring material
More applied AI and research-engineer questions

next_extraction_pass: Search each company with exact role and level combinations such as SDE-1, SDE-2, senior, ML engineer and applied AI engineer.
Prefer first-hand candidate reports over preparation guides and count independent reports before promoting a pattern.
Extract follow-up questions and evaluation signals separately from the headline question.
Track interview date separately from page update date to avoid stale evidence.
Add contradiction records when two credible reports describe different loops for the same company.

source_layers.promotion_rule: Never promote to high-confidence evidence without independent first-hand or official support.
Use as context or a question-generation signal, not as proof of interview practice.

evidence_record_schema.privacy: Store only public, relevant professional facts; do not retain personal contact details or sensitive personal information.

recency_policy.weighting: Recent evidence gets more weight, but older official process material remains useful for stable principles.
recency_policy.stale_handling: Keep stale records for historical context and reduce their promotion power; do not delete them silently.

pattern_promotion_rules: A repeated question family requires at least two independent reports unless an official source directly confirms the process area.
A company-wide claim requires evidence across more than one role or an official company-wide statement.
A role-specific claim must retain role and level; never merge intern, SDE-1, SDE-2, senior and research loops without labels.
Duplicate wording across aggregators counts as one evidence cluster, not multiple reports.
If credible sources disagree, preserve both variants and lower confidence rather than averaging them into one loop.

Meta.mock_interview_effect: Add product metrics, ranking/feed trade-offs and scale follow-ups after core coding or design.

Google.mock_interview_effect: Probe correctness, complexity, reliability and operational trade-offs rather than only algorithm recall.

Sarvam AI.mock_interview_effect: Add offline/no-external-API builds, data-quality reasoning, multilingual evaluation and inference-performance trade-offs.

Swiggy.mock_interview_effect: Connect design and ML answers to latency, reliability, cost, ETA/SLA and user impact.

Locus.sh.mock_interview_effect: Test constraint modeling, online re-optimization, degraded-mode behavior and operational feedback loops.

contradiction_register_template.default_resolution: Keep both variants, label the likely role/level/team scope, and avoid presenting either as universal.

next_high_value_extractions: Extract level-specific signals from current job descriptions and map them to rubric dimensions without calling them interview questions.
Mine follow-up questions and interviewer interventions, not just headline problems.
Build topic-frequency counts by independent evidence cluster and role level.
Compare public interview evidence with company engineering/product signals to detect domain-specific probes.
Run contradiction and stale-source audits before every mock-interview generation.
